verses.t: At one time the Buddha was staying at Sāvatthī in the Jeta Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s Monastery. At that time the monks from the group of six gave teachings to people holding knives. … a weapon with a single-edged or double-edged blade. One should not give a teaching to anyone holding a knife who is not sick. If a monk, out of disrespect, gives a teaching to someone holding a knife who is not sick, he commits an offense of wrong conduct. if he is the first offender. The ninth training rule is finished.
“‘I will not give a teaching to anyone holding a knife who is not sick,’ this is how you should train.”
